技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 4px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with linear-gradient(to right bottom, rgba(230, 162, 74, 0.35), rgba(77, 163, 255, 0.18), rgba(244, 241, 232, 0.03)) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• 间距需对齐检测到的 4px 节奏。
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• 圆角需保持在检测到的 9999px 族系内。
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 没有明确理由时，不要超过检测到的极简动效强度。
动效
动效保持克制，以界面为主导，覆盖文字、布局与滚动过渡。 时序主要聚集在 2000ms 与 150ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 滚动编排采用 GSAP ScrollTrigger 控制区块显现与节奏。

WebGL
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the graphics as a inset 3d accent using webgl, renderer, alpha, DPR 限制, custom shaders. The effect should read as retro-futurist, technical, and meditative: perspective grid field with green on black and sparse spacing. Build it from grid lines + depth fade so the effect reads clearly. Animate it as slow breathing pulse. Interaction can react to the pointer, but only as a subtle drift. Preserve dom fallback.

三维引擎
三维引擎 + WebGL
Reconstruct the 三维引擎 layer as a inset 3d accent 与层叠空间纵深 that feels retro-futurist, volumetric, and technical. Use alpha, DPR 限制 renderer settings, perspective, ~35deg fov, box + custom buffer geometry geometry, shadermaterial materials, and 环境光 + 主光 + 轮廓光 lighting. Motion should read as slow orbital drift, with poster frame + dom fallback.
